topic: Baltic Freight 2: Transport, stock and suppliers
title: Baltic Freight 2: Transport, stock and suppliers
lead: A week later you already know the team. Today you choose transport for a big cargo, help a shop with its stock and talk to a supplier on the phone.
how: You work at Baltic Freight, a logistics company. Choose what you say.
Green ✓ is right. Red ✕ is not this one. You can try again and you will see what to say. Right the first time? You get a star ★.
Tap an underlined word to see what it means.

words.definition: goods that a ship, plane or truck carries
words.example: A company must send a big cargo from China to Lithuania.

words.definition: a very big metal box for carrying goods
words.example: The cargo goes in a container, and the container travels to a port.

words.definition: to look at two things to see how they are different
words.example: The logistics manager compares the cost and the speed.

words.definition: the amount of money you must pay
words.example: The logistics manager compares the cost and the speed.

words.definition: a place by the sea where ships load and unload
words.example: A truck takes them from the port to a warehouse.
If there is too little stock, the product is out of stock and customers go to another shop.

words.definition: too many goods in the warehouse
a list of all the goods that a company has
words.example: Every day the manager checks the inventory on the computer.

words.definition: the amount of something that people want to buy
words.example: She looks at the demand, so she knows which products people buy fast.

words.definition: a company that sells goods to other companies
words.example: She also talks to customers and suppliers every day.

words.definition: doing what you say and not causing problems
words.example: The company needs reliable suppliers because late goods stop the work.

words.definition: a written price for goods or work
words.example: First, the buyer asks three suppliers for a quote.

words.definition: to talk to reach an agreement
words.example: Then the buyer compares the quotes and negotiates with the best supplier.

words.definition: how good or bad something is
words.example: They talk about the price, the quality and the delivery time.

words.definition: to say yes to the same idea
words.example: When they agree, they sign a contract.

words.definition: a written agreement between two companies
words.example: When they agree, they sign a contract.
